method: scripts/check-fitness.ts --measure on the working tree. A mention line is a line of a .md file under a component's paths (atlas.yaml components) that contains another component's mention text; core is scanned with its mention-in expressions, so core-to-agentic-sdlc counts {{AGENT_HOME}}/frameworks/agentic-sdlc paths and core-to-companies counts {{AGENT_HOME}}/companies/ paths that are not placeholders such as companies/<co>/. A check is a check-*.mjs or validate*.mjs file under a component's paths that mentions another component, counted once per file. The two kinds never share a file.

reconciliation.note: The spec's 123 lines in 73 files for knowledge to agentic-sdlc (DR-404, AC-1.6) is the sum of the two kinds: 117 lines in 72 .md files plus the 6 lines of the one check file, copilot/frameworks/knowledge/tools/validate-knowledge.mjs, which is counted under checks-reading-other-areas.
